runStats.frozen: Runs already started keep the setting they started with.
runStats.intro: Gives {name} a read-only tool, run_stats, that shows its own recent runs, failure causes, durations, spend, pending approvals, parked runs and tasks. Only this Bot's own figures in this workspace; never another Bot's, and never the content of anyone's private chat.
runStats.strategyNote: Giving a Bot this tool changes how it works; compare it on paired runs before relying on it.
runStats.title: Run statistics
